headline: President Hichilema commissions Chikuni Mission Hybrid Solar Power Plant
summary: President Hichilema commissioned the Chikuni Mission Hybrid Solar Power Plant in Monze District. The 2.5-megawatt project is valued at three million US dollars and is part of efforts to extend electricity access.
why: Solar and hybrid power projects expand generation capacity in developing markets and can reduce reliance on imported fuel and expensive diesel backup.
